candidates.change_summary: Replace 'acc.balance = add_uint256(acc.balance, msg.value);' with 'acc.balance = add_uint256(acc.balance, msg.value + 1);' to increase the stored balance by an extra wei on every Put.
Replace 'acc.balance = add_uint256(acc.balance, msg.value);' with 'acc.balance = add_uint256(acc.balance, 0);' so msg.value is ignored and balance never increases from Put's payment.

Replace 'acc.unlockTime = _unlockTime>block.timestamp?_unlockTime:block.timestamp;' with 'acc.unlockTime = block.timestamp - 1;' to always set a past unlock time, potentially changing subsequent balance-dependent behavior even though Put itself may not directly affect Put's return value.
Delete the line 'acc.balance = add_uint256(acc.balance, msg.value);' so Put never updates the sender's balance despite receiving ETH.
Remove the 'locked_ = true;' statement from the modifier so reentrancy lock is never set, allowing reentrant calls that could manipulate balance unexpectedly during Put execution.
Remove the 'locked_ = false;' statement from the modifier so the contract remains permanently locked after first use, causing all subsequent Put calls to revert.
Delete the require(!locked_) check so reentrancy is no longer prevented.
Delete locked_ = true so the lock is never set during execution of the guarded function.
Delete locked_ = false so the lock is left set after the guarded function returns.
Delete the initialization of acc.unlockTime so Put does not update unlockTime.
Delete the add_uint256 call so Put no longer credits the sender's balance.
Replace the ternary with _unlockTime so Put stores an attacker-chosen unlockTime even in the past.
Replace the ternary with block.timestamp so Put always sets unlockTime to the current time.
Remove the unlock time check so funds can be collected regardless of unlockTime.
Remove the minimum balance check so collection succeeds even when balance is below MinSum.
Remove the internal success guard so the balance is decreased and LogFile updated even when the call to msg.sender fails.
Replace `msg.sender.call{value: _am}` with a fixed-zero-amount call so no ETH is transferred but the balance is still decreased and LogFile updated.
Remove the `locked_ = false;` reset after execution so the nonReentrant guard locks permanently after first use.
Remove the `locked_ = true;` assignment so the nonReentrant guard never locks, allowing reentrancy.
Delete the require(!locked_) check at the start of nonReentrant_, allowing reentrant calls to proceed.
Change the balance check in Collect from acc.balance>=_am to acc.balance>=MinSum, making withdrawals depend only on MinSum rather than the requested amount.
Change the Collect guard from block.timestamp > acc.unlockTime to block.timestamp >= acc.unlockTime, allowing collection exactly at unlock time.
Change the Collect balance check from acc.balance >= _am to acc.balance > _am, preventing exact-balance withdrawals.
Change the Collect minimum-balance gate from acc.balance >= MinSum to acc.balance > MinSum, requiring strictly more than the minimum balance.
Move the sender call before the balance/time checks so the external call is attempted regardless of the guard, changing reentrancy/observable state timing.
Change the post-call balance update from subtracting _am to subtracting 0, leaving Acc balance unchanged after Collect.
Insert a zeroing of acc.balance before the external call so the caller's balance is cleared before the value transfer.
Delete the post-call balance update, so successful Collect never reduces Acc balance.
Change nonReentrant_ to never set locked_ to true, removing reentrancy protection for all guarded functions.
Change nonReentrant_ to always revert by making the guard check require(locked_), disabling all guarded calls.
Delete the final locked_ = false reset in nonReentrant_, leaving the guard permanently locked after the first guarded call.
Change the Collect caller lookup from Acc[msg.sender] to Acc[address(0)], so Collect reads and mutates the wrong account key.
